about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Rust Runners, where the apocalypse meets high-octane driving and vehicle combat. In this desolate wasteland, survival isn't just about speed—it's about firepower, strategy, and customization.

The highways have been taken over by a family of power hungry people wanting control over resources. You are hired by Tori, the leader of the free people, to help clean up the mess and bring peace back to the highways.

  • Collect and choose from 16 different vehicles, each with its own strengths and weaknesses

  • Upgrade your ride with an arsenal of weapons, from mounted guns to rocket launchers.

  • Enhance performance with Turbochargers, Superchargers and Nitrous Oxide boosts for an advantage over the hostiles.

  • Reinforce your vehicle with Armor Upgrades to withstand the toughest battles

  • Different weapons for engaging in intense firefights

  • Utilize strategic tools like Oil Slicks to spin-out opponents

  • Deploy Grapple Winches to gain tactical advantages in combat and movement

  • Unleash powerful Honing Rockets to hunt down and disable enemy vehicles

  • Gain experience points through battles to level up your driver

  • Customize your driver's skills and abilities to match your playstyle

  • Discover new technologies as you progress, becoming a true highway legend

  • Protect valuable convoys from marauding hostiles

  • Take on lucrative jobs to earn iron, the post-apocalyptic currency

  • Engage in an epic clean-up operations against hostile threats

  • Prove your worth as a Rust Runner through increasingly challenging jobs

  • Face off against 5 formidable bosses, each with unique vehicles and abilities

  • Employ different strategies and loadouts to overcome these powerful adversaries

  • Reclaim the highways and make them peaceful again

  • Explore a vast, post-apocalyptic landscape filled with danger and opportunity

  • Encounter events and challenges that keep the gameplay fresh and exciting

  • Engage in all-out war in the struggle for resources and dominance

Rust Runners combines the thrill of driving with the intensity of combat and useful RPG progression. Will you rise to become the most feared and respected driver in this unforgiving wasteland? Strap in, load up, and prepare to reclaim the highways!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and Up
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen R3
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 1600 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 and Up
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen R3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 2600 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

short_description: Post-apocalyptic driving, shooting & exploration. Customize 16 vehicles with guns, upgrades and armor. Use tools like the grapple winche and oil slicks to outmaneuver rivals. Battle 5 bosses, and level up your driver. Experience the ultimate blend of combat and exploration with a hint of nostalgia.
